summary: Hudbay Minerals Inc., a copper-focused Canadian mining company listed on TSX and NYSE, furnished a Form 6-K with the SEC on July 31, 2026, solely to correct the record and payment dates of its previously announced quarterly cash dividend. The dividend is C$0.01 per share, declared on July 28, 2026, payable September 25, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 8, 2026. This is an administrative correction of a typographical error in an earlier news release; no other terms changed. The filing is a routine corporate announcement unrelated to any special situation such as M&A, restructuring, or capital return event, and thus does not qualify for a special-situations category.
